input_domain: A list of records with string id and optional value that is an integer (not boolean) or null; a list of string request IDs. Inputs are validated before the measured boundary.
output_contract: Return one object per request occurrence in exactly request order, including repeated requests.
Preserve IDs exactly: strings 07 and 7 differ; case and empty strings are significant.
matches counts all record occurrences for that ID, including duplicate identical records and records with missing or null value.
known counts values that are integers, including zero and negative integers. Missing and null both mean unknown, never zero.
total sums known values exactly as integers; it is null when known is zero, including absent IDs. A known sum of zero is integer zero.
Return exactly id, matches, known, total per object. Do not mutate either input. Dictionary key order is not a semantic requirement; array order is.
No claim is made for malformed inputs, floats, streaming, concurrent callers, persistence, or a remote service.
